'''Maynard''' is [[Warder]] to [[Megda]]. He is a [[Tar Valon]]er.
== Appearance ==
Maynard is barrel-chested.
== History ==
Maynard and Megda went to the [[Toman Head]] region shortly after the [[Seanchan]] landed at [[Falme]], after hearing the rumors of strange women who were using the [[One Power]] to harm others.

He is taken prisoner in [[Tobin's Hollow]] when the Seanchan occupy the village, and is separated from Megda when she is taken ''[[damane]]''. He manages to escape, and is reunited with Megda when she also escapes during the chaos in [[Falme]] when the Seanchan are attacked by the [[Heroes of the Horn]].<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
